subject.title: fix(agents): drop stale internal orphan prompts

question: Should OpenClaw use this PR's selected-internal-drop strategy, or the broader preserve-as-context repair in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759, as the canonical fix for the stale orphaned user-message issue?
rationale: Both open PRs address the same canonical session-state bug with different model-visible prompt semantics, and tests alone do not decide which behavior maintainers want to own.

options.title: Choose canonical strategy first
options.body: Keep both candidates blocked from merge until a maintainer explicitly chooses stale-internal-drop versus preserve-as-context semantics, then close or pause the unselected PR.

options.title: Continue with this PR
options.body: Require redacted embedded-agent runtime proof and explicit acceptance of the six-source internal-drop predicate before merging this branch.

options.title: Use the broader proven candidate
options.body: If maintainers prefer preserve-as-context semantics, continue review on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90759 and close this PR after that path is selected or lands.

recommendation.title: Choose canonical strategy first
recommendation.body: Keep both candidates blocked from merge until a maintainer explicitly chooses stale-internal-drop versus preserve-as-context semantics, then close or pause the unselected PR.

likelyOwner.reason: The choice is closest to the queued-user prompt preservation invariant introduced in the merged active-turn repair.
